method: Studio economics per BRIEF.md: fx 3.3, VAT 18%, card 2%+₪1.2, returns 8% of net, packaging 0; shipping for qty q = unit + (q-1)*max(0, unit-3.72); cheapest shipping option to IL, plus the cheapest option within 20 days. retail_ils = the slot's Israeli-value price from data/economics/pricing/living-room-2026-10-11.json. Margin before marketing (CAC).

sources_checked.CJ: 22 searches (listV2) + 30 product opens + 7 freight quotes, run profit-fix-lighting (1,700 points incl. 429 retries); results cached under data/sources/cj/
sources_checked.AliExpress: repo API data only: scale-2026-10/screen (all rooms, 1,915 lighting rows), scale-2026-10/detail + deep-2026-10 (all rooms), data/sources/aliexpress cache. No aliexpress.com browsing.
